Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the temperature ordering based on visible light colors. According to Wien's Displacement Law, hotter objects emit light at shorter wavelengths (higher energy). In the visible spectrum, Blue light (~450-495 nm) has a shorter wavelength and higher frequency than Orange (~590-620 nm) and Red (~620-750 nm). Therefore, the correct order from highest to lowest temperature should be Blue (Object 1) > Orange (Object 3) > Red (Object 2). The Planner mistakenly ordered them as Blue > Red > Orange, placing Red (coolest) above Orange (intermediate), which is physically incorrect.
